name: Atmospheric Pressure can be learned and cast at the reporter's own level, and stays exclusive (#5218)
contract: Issue #5218 (class 16 Stormbringer, lvl 23): 'I cant cast Atmospheric Pressure, but i can cast Crushing Pressure and Barometric Pressure both, i should only activate one Pressure spell.' stormbringer-5218-pressure-exclusivity.json already proves the stacking fix (#5640, spell_group 1170) at level 60; AscensionCustomClassData.h gates Barometric/Crushing/Atmospheric at levels 12/18/22, all below the reporter's level 23, and the trainer (rev_20260923_05_coa_class_trainer_core.sql, entry 900016) teaches all three there. This scenario repeats the castability and exclusivity checks at level 23 itself: Atmospheric Pressure must be learnable and must land a normal cast with no cast failure, and casting it must still remove whichever other Pressure aura is active, matching the already-fixed group 1170 stack rule.

steps.label: SETUP: Atmospheric Pressure is learnable at level 23
SETUP: Barometric Pressure casts cleanly at level 23
CONTRACT: Atmospheric Pressure casts cleanly at level 23, the reporter's own level
CONTRACT: Atmospheric removes Barometric at level 23 too
SETUP: Crushing Pressure casts cleanly at level 23
CONTRACT: Crushing removes Atmospheric at level 23
